entries.text: The published corpus adds TPC-DS OBT SF1 bundles for DuckDB, DataFusion and ClickHouse Local with the lettered `14a`/`14b`, `23a`/`23b` and `24a`/`24b` ids. ClickHouse Local on chDB 4.1.6 cannot run Q41 and Q44. Submission validation accepts that bundle's partial summary only for those two ids on that benchmark, platform and chDB version; the Explorer still reports it as partial and unranked.
